links.comparator_used: Summaries generated without explicit grounding constraints (ungrounded or unconstrained prompt generation), as implied by the abstract
links.outcome: Clinical alignment of generated summaries (NLI-based faithfulness, uncertainty preservation, omission), plus readability
links.effect: Across three LLMs and 4,500 summaries, grounding constraints consistently improved clinical alignment, especially uncertainty preservation. Faithfulness against retrieved evidence was generally preserved or improved. Effects on omission were model-dependent. No numeric values are given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Improved clinical alignment came at the cost of increased reading difficulty and more medical terminology. Omission effects varied by model.
links.quote: Across three LLMs and 4,500 generated summaries, explicit grounding constraints consistently improve clinical alignment, particularly by improving uncertainty preservation and, once faithfulness is evaluated against retrieved evidence, generally preserving or improving faithfulness, while effects on omission remain model-dependent.
